moments.author: Michael Saylor
moments.why: A short two‑word post interpreted as signaling fresh Bitcoin accumulation, generating massive engagement among crypto‑focused men.

moments.author: Cathie Wood
moments.quote: Many clients and companies simply do not comprehend
moments.why: She warned that AI token usage has exploded and could push US real GDP into double digits—a provocative, data‑driven claim resonating with tech‑savvy men.

moments.author: The White House
moments.quote: HEAR THAT? COLLEGE FOOTBALL IS BACK.
moments.why: The administration’s enthusiastic kickoff to college football sparked backlash from fans who wanted substance over sports commentary.

moments.author: Milo Yiannopoulos
moments.why: His crude reaction to a KFC 'Dirty Louisiana Burger' ad drew huge attention, especially after his ICE detention and deportation.

moments.author: Nicolás Maduro
moments.quote: a small gift of love and hope
moments.why: The jailed Venezuelan leader posted smiling photos from his cell, framing them as a message to supporters—surreal and viral.
